title: Keep agents reconnecting and preserve safe Windows command launchers.
changes: Retain the relay reconnect timer after failed WebSocket handshakes so the agent cannot exit before its next retry; clear it on explicit shutdown.
Prefer the trusted npm-generated remcp.cmd launcher on Windows when a recognizable npm remcp.ps1 would be blocked by PowerShell script execution policy.

Refuse to delete or overwrite custom/symlinked PowerShell launchers and reject installations lacking a valid .cmd launcher before changing package files; never change system ExecutionPolicy or pairing credentials.
Cover real reconnect failures, shutdown, installer repair, Windows x64 and ARM64 command-resolution behavior, and public-client parity with native and cross-platform regression tests.
